ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Extent of Welfare Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the scope of welfare fraud in Minnesota, including the Feeding Our Future scandal, and examine the impact on the state's social services.
questions: What is the extent of welfare fraud in Minnesota?
How has the Feeding Our Future scandal affected the state's social services?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread corruption and shed light on the impact of welfare fraud on vulnerable populations. I recommend pursuing this story to hold those responsible accountable and to ensure that social services are protected.
